purpose: Define which current-method and external-baseline comparisons are scientifically commensurate on the prospective larger RCPSP/VRPTW cohort.

source.selection_rule: Select canonical small-tier RCPSP and VRPTW records excluded from text2opt_template_confirmation_v1 solely because num_vars > 96 or num_constraints > 192.

cohort.claim_boundary: File-level untouched larger-size candidate cohort under the current workspace audit; not proof of historical human outcome blindness, unseen family transfer, or independent template-level sampling.

primary_common_evidence_estimand.name: answer_blind_common_evidence_native_budget_accuracy
primary_common_evidence_estimand.unit: One of 38 frozen public problem identities
primary_common_evidence_estimand.public_atomic_facts: The same content-addressed union of public natural-language description and public structured instance data for every method.
primary_common_evidence_estimand.endpoint: Full-denominator formulation accuracy: candidate safely compiles, reaches the declared optimal solver state, and matches the frozen theoretical optimum at relative tolerance 1e-5 and absolute tolerance 1e-6.
primary_common_evidence_estimand.method_budget: Each method's prospectively frozen native answer-blind schedule; physical requests, retries, reported or reserved tokens, safe-execution coverage and solver calls reported separately.
primary_common_evidence_estimand.failure_rule: Parser, schema, compilation, resource, solve, projection, or exhausted transport failure is incorrect. A global endpoint outage before outcomes are opened reschedules the whole affected block under a predeclared rule.
paired_reporting: paired corrections and regressions versus Base
one-sided exact McNemar/sign test on discordant identities
primary_common_evidence_estimand.interpretation: Ecologically fair under common information and backbone, but not equal compute because native method schedules differ.

required_secondary_views.name: answer_blind_common_evidence_equal_budget_sensitivity
required_secondary_views.difference_from_primary: Apply one shared predeclared physical-request and token ceiling to every method.

required_secondary_views.name: author_native_reproduction
required_secondary_views.difference_from_primary: Use each official method's input representation, feedback schedule and native budget.
required_secondary_views.interpretation: Reproduction and ecological validity only; unequal information and compute prevent an unconditional leaderboard.

required_secondary_views.name: bind_answer_bearing_final
required_secondary_views.difference_from_primary: Use official answer-bearing repair feedback after BIND round one.
required_secondary_views.interpretation: Oracle-assisted upper-information row, always outside the answer-blind primary comparison.

execution_admission.candidate_specific_nonzero_and_byte_chec: Required at compile time; source metadata cannot certify generated candidate size.
execution_admission.same_request_fingerprint_rule: A logical request fingerprint may produce at most one physical send; imported or retried attempts remain charged in the ledger.

n38_exact_power.test: One-sided exact conditional McNemar/sign test at alpha 0.05
n38_exact_power.claim_boundary: The 38-record cohort is powered only for very large paired effects; it is a size-generalization confirmation and mechanism panel, not by itself a definitive cross-method leaderboard.

decision.permitted_current_claim: A unique, evaluator-complete 38-record larger-size RCPSP/VRPTW candidate cohort exists and supports a future common-evidence comparison design.
prohibited_current_claims: The current method has been evaluated on the fresh cohort.
The 38 records establish broad benchmark superiority.
BIND final is an answer-blind comparator.
CoE safe-adapter failures equal native CoE modeling failures.
OptiTrust has a locally runnable official result.
